decisions.reason: As a 2023 product line with several models that builds on the firm's established laser-marking business, it likely embodies meaningful development and launch investment, so management would tend to justify and continue it unless failure were already unmistakable.

This printer is close to the firm's core offer and was given its own web page, signaling visible commitment and strategic fit with its identification and traceability direction, which makes withdrawal within a year unlikely.

Because the product sits near the firm's existing coding portfolio and was publicly promoted on its own page, a large R&D-active German machinery firm would be inclined to persist and attribute any early weakness to temporary market-development factors rather than abandon it quickly.
